svg.text: pod-up.yml invokes the pod-manager Lambda, the only holder of ECS / ALB / EFS write rights (ADR 0003)
auth guard + owner check: refuse if unrestricted
RegisterTaskDefinition (browser: vscode + oauth2-proxy, + owner-authz-init if ownerOnly; tunnel: vscode-tunnel)
CreateRule host-header, priority fnv1a % 49000 + 1000 (re-derived on PriorityInUse)
FilterLogEvents on this task's stream, every 5 s, up to 180 s
step summary: URL, or device code

Any error after the access-point step rolls back: StopTask, DeleteRule, DeleteTargetGroup, and DeleteAccessPoint only if this invocation created it (a reused workspace is never deleted). Refusals before that point (conflict, auth guard, no image) create no pod resources.
